name: Silvies (high desert ranch, Blue Mountains)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Silvies Valley Ranch, Seneca OR, about 4,700 ft up in the Blue Mountains: irrigated fairways and greens a clear green against the dry hills; the native rough of bunchgrass and sage cured to a tawny gold by summer (F0-F2, inside config fescue_areas; mown rough beside the fairways in G3-G5); off the course (L0-L2) the grey-olive of sagebrush steppe, so out of bounds reads apart from the rough; pale tan sand; blue ponds; log-cabin browns. Trees: ponderosa pine and western juniper (assets-src/trees_silvies.py), sagebrush as the theme's bush. Hues chosen for the game's saturated style, to be checked against the OSIP photo once it arrives. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
